whenToUse: Chat, support and team threads laid out turn by turn, with avatars, sender names and read receipts
Assistant replies carrying a copy, regenerate and rating toolbar, or a pending then streaming state
Shared images and documents carried in a turn beside its text

whenNotToUse.when: A text surface on its own, with no avatar slot, metadata row or side switching
A long thread that scrolls and must stay pinned to the newest turn
A complete assistant screen with a composer, a thread switcher and streaming controls

agentNotes: On an `align` end row only children of `MessageContent` that carry a `data-slot` move to the end; a plain element there keeps to the start
`MessageHeader` and `MessageFooter` set no gap, so a header or footer built from several nodes needs its own gap class
